eva_cs: Heads-up — Acme (INV-8923) failed to charge. Customer reported a declined card. Gateway first responded `card_declined: insufficient_funds`, then a follow-up attempt returned `authentication_required`. Putting logs below.

eva_cs: ```json
{
  "tx_id": "tx_8a9f4b",
  "status": "failed",
  "error": "card_declined",
  "decline_code": "insufficient_funds"
}
```

mike_payments: Can you paste the full gateway headers / X-Request-ID? Also — did merchant or our system retry immediately? Rapid retries can flip auth state and trigger acquirer 3DS.

sara_support: Customer on the line said the bank popped an SCA prompt and they cancelled it. They tried once more but got the auth_required. They want a safe retry link.

raj_infra: Observed a short spike on payments-ingest at 2026-02-22T12:03:10Z — several 502s from the acquirer. Our retry policy is 3 attempts w/ 1s backoff for transient errors; that could correlate with the immediate second call hitting auth flow. Suggest suppressing auto-retry when response includes `decline_code` or `authentication_required`.

card-gateway-bot: LOG: tx_8a9f4b -> ACQ_RESP { outcome: "challenge_failed", eci: "05", acquirer_code: "457", auth_attempt_id: "auth_33h2k" }

mike_payments: Action items:
1) Stop programmatic retries for `authentication_required` or explicit `decline_code` responses.
2) Send customer a one-click retry link that triggers a fresh 3DS flow (so issuer can present SCA again).
3) If `insufficient_funds` persists after SCA, advise merchant to request alternate method or contact issuing bank.
I'll open a ticket with the acquirer including `auth_attempt_id`.

sara_support: Repro steps for docs/helpdesk: do NOT call `confirm` again if response is `authentication_required`. Instead present the 3DS URL from the original flow or create a new payment intent and redirect. Example (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/payments/tx_8a9f4b/confirm \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
 -d '{"return_url":"https://acme.example.com/payments/return"}'
```
Note: set a new `idempotency-key` for user-initiated retries so we don't replay the failing auth.

eva_cs: I'll send the retry link to the customer and tell them to complete the bank challenge. @mike_payments please paste the acquirer ticket once you have it.

mike_payments: Ticket created: ACQ-2742. Attached logs, auth_attempt_id, X-Request-IDs, and timeline. Also flagged PaymentRetries policy for review.

raj_infra: I'll open a PR to add conditional retry suppression (skip retries when `decline_code` or `authentication_required` present). ETA EOD.

eva_cs: Thanks all — sending customer message now. Will update when they confirm payment. :thumbsup:
